personalizedSolution.title: This isn’t a motivation problem.
personalizedSolution.copy: The problems you chose happen before your fully awake brain gets a say. Here’s how DawnVow changes each pattern.

solutions.snooze_unaware: A required mission interrupts the automatic snooze loop.
solutions.dismiss_fall_asleep: A mission stands between one sleepy tap and a completed wake-up.
solutions.multiple_alarms: One action-based alarm replaces a chain you’ve learned to ignore.
solutions.louder_background: DawnVow changes what you do instead of only getting louder.
solutions.sleepy_ignores: Awake-you chooses the mission. Sleepy-you has to follow it.
solutions.late_frustrated: Your first completed action gets you moving before the morning slips away.
